events.description: A three-round competition testing strategic thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
rules: Round 1: Brain Buster Blitz (Quiz Round) — both team members collaborate on a quiz of challenging questions, and their combined performance determines advancement.
Round 2: The Riddle Conundrum — teams solve 5 riddles in the shortest possible time. Teams solving the most riddles in the least time advance.
Round 3: Strategic Mastermind (Case Study Presentation) — teams are assigned a common case study focused on strategy formulation.
Teams have 10–12 minutes in total: 5–7 minutes for the presentation and 5 minutes for questions and answers.
Performance is judged on strategic and analytical skills, and judges ask questions for evaluation.

events.description: Participants receive 2 minutes to introduce themselves, followed by leadership questions. This is not an elimination round.
rules: Round 1: Parichaya (Introduction) — participants receive 2 minutes to introduce themselves, followed by leadership questions. This is not an elimination round.
Round 2: Vaad-Vivad (Debate) — participants receive a current topic and must actively participate by clearly presenting their stance without contradicting themselves.
Debate topics are disclosed at the time of the round, which tests spontaneity and persuasiveness.
Round 3: Vaktavya (Elocution) — participants receive an elocution topic, followed by questions from the audience or judges based on the speech content.

events.description: An innovation & entrepreneurship-based event conducted across quiz, case analysis and business-presentation rounds.
rules: Team size: 1–2 members
Round 1: Quizoholic – Objective quiz based on startups & innovation
Round 2: Business Case Study – 25 min written analysis, 100-word limit per question
Round 3: B-Plan Presentation – Max 6 slides, 10 min pitch + Q&A

events.description: Stall Mart is a two-round competition where participants showcase creativity, business acumen, and organizational skills by setting up and managing stalls. The event tests ideation, execution, and revenue-generation skills.
rules: Round 1: Idea Sprint — teams present their stall concept and strategy, including the products or services offered and how they plan to attract customers.
Round 2: The Entrepreneur’s Arena — teams set up and manage stalls based on their proposed ideas. Stalls may feature artistic creations, games with psychological themes, food, and more.
Teams must keep their stalls tidy and organized.
Evaluation is based on revenue generated, productivity, and a task assigned by the Event Coordinators.
No gambling games, objectionable subjects, or unfair means are permitted.
Discipline must be maintained, and only members of the participating team may be in the stall.
Stalls are allotted on a first-come, first-served basis. No disputes will be entertained.
A daily balance sheet must be maintained.

events.description: A creative reel-based entrepreneurship challenge including quiz, brand face-off and product pitching through video creation.
rules: Team size: 2–3 members
Round 1: Business Trivia Quiz
Round 2: Brand Battle – Create humorous reel of two competing brands (45–60 sec)
Round 3: Pitch Perfect – Reel-pitch of a mystery-box product (45–60 sec)
